summary: Lists commands the sample setup enables: running the whole site, one tag, one tier, a location via --limit, host slices, ad hoc commands, and previewing with --list-tasks and --list-hosts.
questions: How do I run only NTP-related tasks across all servers?
How do I deploy to 10 servers at a time with --limit?
How can I see which tasks would run before running a playbook?
How can I see which hosts a playbook would target?
How do I reboot all servers in a group ad hoc?

answer_card.title: Common commands with the sample setup
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
ansible-playbook -i production site.yml                       # everything
ansible-playbook -i production site.yml --tags ntp            # just NTP
ansible-playbook -i production webservers.yml                 # one tier
ansible-playbook -i production webservers.yml --limit boston  # one location
ansible-playbook -i production webservers.yml --limit boston[0:9]
ansible-playbook -i production webservers.yml --limit boston[10:19]

ansible boston -i production -m ping
ansible boston -i production -m command -a '/sbin/reboot'

# preview
ansible-playbook -i production webservers.yml --tags ntp --list-tasks
ansible-playbook -i production webservers.yml --limit boston --list-hosts
```
